about_the_game:
Fight monsters in each night, survive as long as you can! Nocturnal Survivors is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter game in which you simply keep combining your weapons to more powerful versions to kill thousands of monsters at nights.

Gameplay features:

  • Infinite map with day-night cycles (currently 1 map with 4 types of monster in Early Access)

  • Deep weapon combination system (currently 21 weapons in Early Access)

  • Bizarre and powerful artifacts (currently 20 artifacts in Early Access)

And much more in plan.

LATEST UPDATE (May 30, 2025)

RELEASE NOTE 0.1

Comparing to playtest, we made following updates in v0.1:

Gameplay feature:

- New combo weapon: Javelin.

- Efreet does not explode when expired. Instead, incendiary bomb dropped by efreet drone explodes before igniting ground.

- Shotgun and storm gun fire directly to closest enemy. There's no need to face to the enemy first.

- Upgrade: increase damage range cannot be applied on lightning.

- Reduce daytime from 30 seconds to 20 seconds.

- Player heals 5% of maximum health on level up.

- Various balance changes on weapons.

- Detecting buff shows a general detected icon in HUD.

- Add smoke VFX for cluster grenades and rockets.

- Add best records tab in unlock screen. The longest plays are displayed for all difficulties.

- Best record is marked on cycle bar in HUD.

- Add option to pause game when window lost focus in Settings. Enabled by default.

- Show artifact description in mission info screen.

Bugfix:

- Artifact sacrifice plugin works correctly on phoenix drone.

- Upgrade: increase all weapons critical chance and damage works correctly on all weapons.

Technical enhancement:

- None

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 instructions, with 4 physical cores or more, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
